prompt: Which strategic HRM approach (Walton, 1985) is associated with the new algorithmic approaches to work organisation?
explanation: Richtig ist Control: algorithmisches Management überwacht, taktet und bewertet Arbeit eng – die Kontrolllogik (Panopticon, Fließband, Callcenter) statt Commitment.

prompt: Which of the following statements about HRM is false?

options.text: HRM has an impact on human capital and behaviors of employees
HRM practices have efficiency as their main objective
HRM contributes to the achievement of corporate goals
HRM can contribute to employee job satisfaction

explanation: Falsch ist „Effizienz als Hauptziel“: HRM verfolgt mehrere Ziele – Leistung, Wohlbefinden, Fairness, Nachhaltigkeit (Harvard-Modell, Sustainable HRM), nicht nur Effizienz.
